title: Admin navigation, keys clarity and local secret testing
summary: Admin Settings, Email Templates and Access use clearer button-style section tabs; the Email Templates menu label matches the page; and live Cloudron docs steer operators to Keys and secrets for the mailbox password, with a secrets inventory and a local Herd testing path that never puts secret values in the repository.
changes: Admin Settings, Email Templates and Access share one button-style sub-navigation (the same pill style as other Admin section tabs), with the current section marked for screen readers.
The Admin sidebar and page heading for outbound mail templates now read Email Templates; Email import and Inbound stay separate.

Live operator docs and the wiki treat Admin → Settings → Keys and secrets (enter, Test, save) as the primary path for the communications@ mailbox password; the server .env is emergency or fallback only. A names-only inventory lists which secrets have an Admin UI and which stay .env-only.
Herd local docs describe how to exercise Keys and secrets and Integrations with machine-local values or typed Admin values only — never commit or paste production secrets.
version_rationale: Patch: clearer Admin navigation and labels, plus documentation of Keys-primary live secrets handling; no migrations and no new Admin fields for env-only secrets.
validation: PHPUnit coverage for Email Templates nav labels and admin-subnav aria-current on Settings and Email Templates pages passed locally.
composer pre-pr-verify and CI checks on the milestone pull request.
known_limitations: None for this patch. OIDC, LDAP, APP_KEY and INBOUND_MAIL_TOKEN_KEY remain .env-only until a later decision.
rollback: Deploy v0.64.1 with deploy-cloudron.yml. Admin subnav returns to unstyled links and the Emails label returns until a later release; Keys and secrets behaviour is unchanged by this patch.
provenance: Milestone v0.64.2 Beta: Admin navigation, keys clarity and local secret testing, epic #826 with issues #827–#832; pull request #833.
